text:
Just this past Monday, I presented the idea that in the future, we won't write code directly; instead, we will write specifications. AI will generate code based on clearly defined requirements. I called this approach requirement-driven development. 

On that very day, Amazon introduced https://kiro.dev/, an IDE focused on creating specifications first and automatically generating code from these specifications. My prediction, which I expected to happen in three months, materialized immediately.
